analysis: JST R6 predictor, control, and outcome specification bridge

model_sequence.M0: R6 JST Table 8 predictor and controls on the fixed bridge sample, standardized credit effects reported per within-type standard deviation.
model_sequence.M1: Swap to three-year credit growth, retaining event-type slopes, JST controls, lags, country effects, and forward-growth outcomes.
model_sequence.M2: Swap to current severity controls, retaining event-type slopes and country effects.
model_sequence.M3: Add decade fixed effects to M2.
model_sequence.M4: Replace event-type-specific credit slopes with one common slope and retain event-type intercepts.
model_sequence.M5: Drop event-type intercepts to match the current severity regression form.
model_sequence.M6: Keep M5 fixed and replace forward-growth outcomes with peak-to-trough and five-year cumulative losses.

inference: Country-clustered standard errors and t intervals with 13 degrees of freedom. Every bridge model uses the same 94 exact country-year keys.
limitations: The fixed bridge sample is selected from original JST events with complete R6 Table 8 outcomes and predictors.
The 94-event sample is smaller than the 299-event release 6 analysis and does not explain every difference between the studies.
R6 tloans is the closest available match to original loans1, but the definitions are not proven identical.
The analysis is descriptive and does not identify causal effects.
